headline: WHEATON PRECIOUS METALS POSTS RECORD $901M QUARTER — $766M CASH FLOW AS GOLD, SILVER SURGE
snippet: Canada's largest precious metals streamer reported Q1 2026 revenue of $901M, net earnings of $582M, and operating cash flow of $766M — all company records — as gold near $4,700/oz and silver near $80/oz lifted margins across its royalty and streaming portfolio. Conference call held May 8.

headline: SILVER TOPS $80 AN OUNCE FOR FIRST TIME, UP 147% YEAR-OVER-YEAR ON US-IRAN TENSIONS
snippet: Silver hit $80.71/oz on May 8 — up nearly 3% on the day and 147% year-over-year — as renewed US-Iran clashes in the Strait of Hormuz reignited safe-haven demand and inflation concerns. Gold held near $4,706/oz, up 42% from a year ago.

headline: HECLA EYES $6.8 BILLION IN METALS LOCKED IN GREENS CREEK TAILINGS — 98% SILVER RECOVERY IN TESTS
snippet: Hecla Mining is evaluating two upgrades at North America's largest silver mine: a tailings reprocessing project targeting $6.8B in accumulated metals — phase testing showed 98.1% silver and 99.5% gold recovery — and a new pyrite concentrate circuit to capture metals currently reporting to waste. Neither initiative is expected to require major capital expenditure.

headline: SSR MINING STOCK EXPLODES 20% — Q1 EPS $1.15 CRUSHES $0.79 ESTIMATE, ZERO DEBT, $210M FREE CASH
snippet: SSR Mining posted Q1 EPS of $1.15 — a 46% beat — on $581M in revenue with $210M+ in free cash flow and zero net debt after redeeming its convertible notes. The company is on track to close a $1.5B sale of the Copler mine before year-end and refocus entirely on its Americas gold and silver portfolio.

headline: COPPER ABOVE $6.24 A POUND AS BHP CFO SAYS AI DATA CENTER INVESTORS FLOODING INTO THE METAL
snippet: Copper held above $6.24/lb on May 8 — up 35% year-over-year — as BHP's CFO told the Macquarie Australia Conference that a new class of generalist investors is buying the miner for copper exposure tied to AI data centers. Copper has now surpassed iron ore as BHP's biggest earnings contributor for the first time. US-Iran clashes disrupting sulphuric acid shipments add further supply-side risk.

headline: G7 TRADE MINISTERS IN PARIS MAKE CRITICAL MINERALS TOP PRIORITY AS CHINA SUPPLY RISKS DOMINATE AGENDA
snippet: G7 trade ministers meeting in Paris on May 5-6 named critical mineral supply chain security the most concrete deliverable ahead of the June leaders' summit. All seven nations agreed on reducing China dependence for chips, EV batteries, and magnets — though US tariff threats on EU autos complicated the unified front.

headline: MP MATERIALS: PENTAGON PRICE FLOOR + $500M APPLE DEAL LOCK IN THE ONLY INTEGRATED US RARE EARTH PLAY
snippet: MP Materials (NYSE: MP) — operator of the only large-scale US rare earth mine at Mountain Pass — holds a Pentagon-guaranteed $110/kg NdPr floor price (DoD owns 15% of the company) and a $500M recycled magnet supply agreement with Apple. The company is commissioning its Fort Worth magnet facility in 2026, building the first vertically integrated US rare earth-to-magnet supply chain. Stock up 30%+ year-to-date.

headline: RARE EARTH PRICES SLIDE — NdPr OXIDE DROPS 21% IN APRIL AS CHINA QUOTA DECISION LOOMS IN JUNE
snippet: NdPr oxide fell 21% in April to $99.61/kg — its steepest monthly decline of the year — dragging neodymium oxide to $108.96/kg and praseodymium oxide to $109.60/kg. Analysts expect prices to consolidate in a $95–$115/kg domestic range through Q2, with China's mid-year MIIT mining quota announcement (typically June) as the key catalyst to watch.

headline: CHILE LITHIUM EXPORTS SURGE 175% IN APRIL AS SQM-CODELCO PARTNERSHIP RAMPS OUTPUT
snippet: Chile's April 2026 lithium carbonate exports reached $498M — up 175.6% year-on-year — as the SQM-Codelco state partnership ramps production through 2026, with Q1 lithium shipment volumes rising 25%. Despite the surge in output, lithium prices remain far below their 2022 peak, reflecting the global supply glut.

headline: GLOBAL MINING DEALS HIT $21.6 BILLION IN STRONGEST Q1 SINCE 2023 AS CRITICAL MINERALS DRIVE M&A
snippet: Global mining M&A reached $21.6B in Q1 2026 — the strongest opening quarter since 2023 — following a 13-year full-year high of $93.7B in 2025. Critical mineral supply-chain strategy is reshaping deal priorities, with US projects attracting 48% of announced funding in January and strategic partnerships now accounting for nearly a third of all transaction structures.

headline: MAXUS MINING LAUNCHES MAIDEN DRILL PROGRAM AT ALTURAS WEST COPPER-GOLD PROJECT IN BRITISH COLUMBIA
snippet: Maxus Mining has launched a maiden drill program alongside concurrent metallurgical testing at its Alturas West copper-gold project in British Columbia. The campaign marks the company's first drill hole at the property and advances the project toward its first resource estimate.

headline: WEST POINT GOLD HITS 22.9M AT 3.11 G/T IN ARIZONA; FIVE JUNIORS DRILLING ADJACENT TO MAJOR MINES
snippet: West Point Gold reported drill results from the Tyro Main Zone at its Gold Chain Project in Arizona: 22.9 metres at 3.11 g/t gold and a 184-metre composite interval averaging 1.00 g/t from surface. A roundup of five juniors drilling adjacent to major operations also highlights GoldMining's São Jorge program in Brazil, where initial holes returned 12m at 2.38 g/t gold.
